title: The lib2to3 module was removed in Python 3.13
summary: Python 3.13 removed lib2to3, so importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError; use a maintained parser such as libcst or tree-sitter.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the lib2to3 import
steps.instructions: Replace each reported import of lib2to3 with libcst or tree-sitter.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings treated as errors when pytest is used.
